modalities.evidence: structured radiology report dataset built upon RadGraph

output.population: 550 manually annotated MIMIC-CXR reports, 50 CheXpert reports, and 227,835 automatically annotated MIMIC-CXR reports
output.summary: Structured radiology reports in RadGraph format with five entity types, four relation types and three entity attributes; manually annotated MIMIC-CXR and CheXpert reports plus model-inferred annotations for automatic report generation.
